units.zh: 崔暹 高德政 崔昂
units.en: Cui Xian; Gao Dezheng; Cui Ang
units.literal: Cui Xian; Gao Dezheng; Cui Ang

units.zh: 崔暹，字季倫，博陵安平人，漢尚書寔之後也，世為北州著姓。
units.en: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han minister of works, and for generations a leading house of the northern provinces.
units.literal: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han Minister of Works, and for generations a prominent clan of the northern provinces.

units.zh: 父穆，州主簿。
units.en: His father Mu was a provincial clerk.
units.literal: His father Mu was a commandery clerk.

units.zh: 暹少為書生，避地渤海，依高乾，以妹妻乾弟慎。
units.en: In youth Xian was a student; he fled to Bohai and attached himself to Gao Gan, giving his sister in marriage to Gan's brother Shen.
units.literal: In youth Xian was a student; he fled to Bohai and relied on Gao Gan, giving his sister in marriage to Gan's brother Shen.

units.zh: 慎後臨光州，啟暹為長史。
units.en: When Shen later governed Guangzhou, he had Xian appointed chief clerk.
units.literal: When Shen later held Guangzhou, he had Xian appointed chief clerk.

units.zh: 趙郡公琛鎮定州，辟為開府諮議。
units.en: Duke of Zhao Commandery Chen, defending Dingzhou, engaged him as deliberator of the grand marshalate.
units.literal: Duke of Zhao Commandery Chen, defending Dingzhou, engaged him as deliberator of the grand marshalate.

units.zh: 隨琛往晉陽，高祖與語說之，以兼丞相長史。
units.en: Following Chen to Jinyang, Gao Huan conversed with him and was pleased, appointing him acting chief clerk to the chancellor.
units.literal: Following Chen to Jinyang, Gao Huan conversed with him and was pleased, appointing him acting chief clerk to the chancellor.

units.zh: 高祖舉兵將入洛，留暹佐琛知後事。
units.en: When Gao Huan raised troops to enter Luoyang, he left Xian to assist Chen in managing affairs behind the lines.
units.literal: When Gao Huan raised troops to enter Luoyang, he left Xian to assist Chen in managing rear affairs.

units.zh: 謂之曰：「丈夫相知，豈在新舊。
units.en: He said to him, "When men know one another, is it a matter of new or old?
units.literal: He said to him: "When men know one another, is it a matter of new or old?

units.zh: 軍戎事重，留守任切，家弟年少，未閑事宜，凡百後事，一以相屬。」
units.en: Military affairs are weighty and the duty of holding the rear is pressing; my younger brother is young and not yet versed in affairs—for every matter behind, I entrust all to you."
units.literal: Military affairs are weighty, and the duty of staying behind is pressing; my younger brother is young and not yet versed in affairs—for every matter behind, I entrust all to you."

units.zh: 握手殷勤，至於三四。
units.en: They clasped hands earnestly, three or four times over.
units.literal: They clasped hands earnestly, three or four times.

units.zh: 後遷左丞、吏部郎，主議《麟趾格》。
units.en: Later he was moved to left vice director and director of the ministry of personnel, and took chief part in deliberating the Linzhi Code.
units.literal: Later he was moved to left vice director and director of the ministry of personnel, and took chief part in deliberating the Linzhi Code.

units.zh: 暹親遇日隆，好薦人士。
units.en: Xian's personal favor grew day by day; he delighted in recommending men of talent.
units.literal: Xian's personal favor grew day by day; he delighted in recommending men of talent.

units.zh: 言邢卲宜任府僚，兼任機密，世宗因以徵卲，甚見親重。
units.en: He said Xing Shao was fit for a staff post with access to secret affairs; Gao Cheng thereupon summoned Shao, who was greatly favored and trusted.
units.literal: He said Xing Shao was fit for a staff post with access to secret affairs; Gao Cheng thereupon summoned Shao, who was greatly favored and trusted.

units.zh: 言論之際，卲遂毀暹。
units.en: In the course of talk, Shao then slandered Xian.
units.literal: In the course of talk, Shao then slandered Xian.

units.zh: 世宗不悅，謂暹曰：「卿說子才之長，子才專言卿短，此癡人也。」
units.en: Gao Cheng was displeased and said to Xian, "You speak of Zicai's strengths, yet Zicai speaks only of your faults—this is a foolish man."
units.literal: Gao Cheng was displeased and said to Xian: "You speak of Zicai's strengths, yet Zicai speaks only of your faults—this is a foolish man."

units.zh: 暹曰：「子才言暹短，暹說子才長，皆是實事，不為嫌也。」
units.en: Xian said, "Zicai speaks of Xian's faults; Xian speaks of Zicai's strengths—each states what is true, without rancor."
units.literal: Xian said: "Zicai speaks of Xian's faults; Xian speaks of Zicai's strengths—each states what is true, without rancor."

units.zh: 高慎之叛，與暹有隙，高祖欲殺之，世宗救免。
units.en: When Gao Shen rebelled, having a rift with Xian, Gao Huan wished to kill him; Gao Cheng rescued and pardoned him.
units.literal: When Gao Shen rebelled, having a rift with Xian, Gao Huan wished to kill him; Gao Cheng rescued and pardoned him.

units.zh: 武定初，遷御史中尉，選畢義雲、盧潛、宋欽道、李愔、崔瞻、杜蕤、嵇曄、酈伯偉、崔子武、李廣皆為御史，世稱其知人。
units.en: At the beginning of Wuding, he was moved to chief inspector; he selected Bi Yiyun, Lu Qian, Song Qindao, Li Yin, Cui Zhan, Du Rui, Ji Ye, Li Bowei, Cui Ziwu, and Li Guang as inspectors—men of the age called this knowing men.
units.literal: At the beginning of Wuding, he was moved to chief inspector; he selected Bi Yiyun, Lu Qian, Song Qindao, Li Yin, Cui Zhan, Du Rui, Ji Ye, Li Bowei, Cui Ziwu, and Li Guang as inspectors—men of the age called this knowing men.

units.zh: 世宗欲假暹威勢，諸公在坐，令暹高視徐步，兩人掣裾而入，世宗分庭對揖。
units.en: Gao Cheng wished to lend Xian imposing bearing; with the lords seated, he had Xian walk in with head high and slow steps, two men tugging his robes to lead him in; Gao Cheng faced him across the hall and bowed with equal ceremony.
units.literal: Gao Cheng wished to lend Xian imposing bearing; with the lords seated, he had Xian walk in with head high and slow steps, two men tugging his robes to lead him in; Gao Cheng faced him across the hall and bowed with equal ceremony.

units.zh: 暹不讓席而坐，觴再行，便辭退。
units.en: Xian would not yield the seat but sat down; after two rounds of wine he took his leave.
units.literal: Xian would not yield the seat but sat down; after two rounds of wine he took his leave.

units.zh: 世宗曰：「下官薄有蔬食，願公少留。」
units.en: Gao Cheng said, "This humble officer has a modest vegetarian meal; I hope you will stay a little."
units.literal: Gao Cheng said: "This humble officer has a modest vegetarian meal; I hope you will stay a little."

units.zh: 暹曰：「適受勑在臺檢校。」
units.en: Xian said, "I have just received orders to inspect at the bureau."
units.literal: Xian said: "I have just received orders to inspect at the bureau."

units.zh: 遂不待食而去，世宗降階送之。
units.en: Without waiting for the meal he left; Gao Cheng descended the steps to see him off.
units.literal: Without waiting for the meal he left; Gao Cheng descended the steps to see him off.

units.zh: 旬日後，世宗與諸公出之東山，遇暹於道，前驅為赤棒所擊，世宗回馬避之。
units.en: Ten days later, Gao Cheng went out to the eastern hills with the lords and met Xian on the road; the outriders were struck with red staffs and Gao Cheng turned his horse aside to avoid him.
units.literal: Ten days later, Gao Cheng went out to the eastern hills with the lords and met Xian on the road; the outriders were struck with red staffs and Gao Cheng turned his horse aside to avoid him.

units.zh: 暹前後表彈尚書令司馬子如及尚書元羨、雍州刺史慕容獻，又彈太師咸陽王坦、幷州刺史可朱渾道元，罪狀極筆，並免官。
units.en: Xian successively memorialized and impeached Minister of Works Sima Ziru, the minister Yuan Xian, and Administrator of Yong province Murong Xian, and also impeached Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang Tan and inspector of Bing province Kezhuhun Daoyuan—the charges written to the utmost; all were removed from office.
units.literal: Xian successively memorialized and impeached Minister of Works Sima Ziru and the minister Yuan Xian and Administrator of Yong province Murong Xian, also impeached Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang Wang Tan and Inspector of Bing province Kezhuhun Daoyuan—the charges written to the utmost; all were removed from office.

units.zh: 其餘死黜者甚衆。
units.en: Of the rest, those killed or dismissed were very many.
units.literal: Of the rest, those killed or dismissed were very many.

units.zh: 高祖書與鄴下諸貴曰：「崔暹昔事家弟為定州長史，後吾兒開府諮議，及遷左丞吏部郎，吾未知其能也。
units.en: Gao Huan wrote to the nobles at Ye, "Cui Xian once served my younger brother as chief clerk of Dingzhou, later my son's grand marshalate deliberator, and when moved to left vice director and director of the ministry of personnel I did not yet know his ability.
units.literal: Gao Huan wrote to the nobles at Ye: "Cui Xian once served my younger brother as chief clerk of Dingzhou, later my son's grand marshalate deliberator, and when moved to left vice director and director of the ministry of personnel I did not yet know his ability.

units.zh: 始居憲臺，乃爾糾劾。
units.en: Only when he took the inspectorate did he correct and impeach thus.
units.literal: Only when he took the inspectorate did he correct and impeach thus.

units.zh: 咸陽王、司馬令並是吾對門布衣之舊，尊貴親昵，無過二人，同時獲罪，吾不能救，諸君其慎之。」
units.en: Prince of Xianyang and Minister Sima were both my old companions of common cloth opposite the gate, honored and intimate beyond all others; at the same time they incurred guilt—I could not save them; gentlemen, be wary."
units.literal: Prince of Xianyang and Minister Sima were both my old companions of common cloth opposite the gate, honored and intimate beyond all others; at the same time they incurred guilt—I could not save them; gentlemen, be wary."

units.zh: 高祖如京師，羣官迎於紫陌。
units.en: When Gao Huan went to the capital, the officials welcomed him at Zimo.
units.literal: When Gao Huan went to the capital, the officials welcomed him at Zimo.

units.zh: 高祖握暹手而勞之曰：「往前朝廷豈無法官，而天下貪婪，莫肯糾劾。
units.en: Gao Huan took Xian's hand and praised him, "Before, was there no judge in the court? Yet greed ran through the realm and none would impeach.
units.literal: Gao Huan took Xian's hand and praised him: "Before, was there no judge in the court? Yet greed ran through the realm and none would impeach.

units.zh: 中尉盡心為國，不避豪強，遂使遠邇肅清，羣公奉法。
units.en: The chief inspector has devoted his heart to the state, not avoiding the powerful, and thus near and far are brought to order and the lords uphold the law.
units.literal: The chief inspector has devoted his heart to the state, not avoiding the powerful, and thus near and far are brought to order and the lords uphold the law.

units.zh: 衝鋒陷陣，大有其人，當官正色，今始見之。
units.en: To charge battle lines—there are many such men; to hold office with upright countenance—only now do I see it.
units.literal: To charge battle lines—there are many such men; to hold office with upright countenance—only now do I see it.

units.zh: 今榮華富貴，直是中尉自取，高歡父子，無以相報。」
units.en: Wealth and glory today are simply what the chief inspector has earned for himself; father and son Gao Huan have no way to repay it."
units.literal: Wealth and glory today are simply what the chief inspector has earned for himself; father and son Gao Huan have no way to repay it."

units.zh: 賜暹良馬，使騎之以從，且行且語。
units.en: He granted Xian a fine horse and had him ride alongside, talking as they went.
units.literal: He granted Xian a fine horse and had him ride alongside, talking as they went.

units.zh: 暹下拜，馬驚走，高祖為擁之而授轡。
units.en: Xian bowed; the horse bolted in fright; Gao Huan embraced him and handed him the reins.
units.literal: Xian bowed; the horse bolted in fright; Gao Huan embraced him and handed him the reins.

units.zh: 魏帝宴於華林園，謂高祖曰：「自頃朝貴、牧守令長、所在百司多有貪暴，侵削下人。
units.en: The Wei emperor feasted at Hualin Garden and said to Gao Huan, "Of late, court nobles, prefects and county chiefs, and the hundred offices in every place have many been greedy and violent, encroaching on inferiors.
units.literal: The Wei emperor feasted at Hualin Garden and said to Gao Huan: "Of late, court nobles, prefects and county chiefs, and the hundred offices in every place have many been greedy and violent, encroaching on inferiors.

units.zh: 朝廷之中有用心公平，直言彈劾，不避親戚者，王可勸酒。」
units.en: In the court there are those who apply their hearts with fairness and impeach in straight speech, not avoiding kin—Wang may urge them to drink."
units.literal: In the court there are those who apply their hearts with fairness and impeach in straight speech, not avoiding kin—Wang may urge them to drink."

units.zh: 高祖降階，跪而言曰：「唯御史中尉崔暹一人。
units.en: Gao Huan descended the steps, knelt, and said, "Only Chief Inspector Cui Xian, one man.
units.literal: Gao Huan descended the steps, knelt, and said: "Only Chief Inspector Cui Xian, one man.

units.zh: 謹奉明旨，敢以酒勸，並臣所射賜物千疋，乞回賜之。」
units.en: Reverently following the clear command, I dare urge wine upon him—and furthermore the thousand bolts of cloth from my archery gift, I beg they be turned and given to him."
units.literal: Reverently following the clear command, I dare urge wine upon him—and furthermore the thousand bolts of cloth from my archery gift, I beg they be turned and given to him."

units.zh: 帝曰：「崔中尉為法，道俗齊整。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Chief Inspector Cui upholds the law; ways and customs are alike regulated."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Chief Inspector Cui upholds the law; ways and customs are alike regulated."

units.zh: 暹謝曰：「此自陛下風化所加，大將軍臣澄勸獎之力。」
units.en: Xian thanked him, "This is from Your Majesty's transforming influence, and the urging and reward of my lord Grand General Cheng."
units.literal: Xian thanked him: "This is from Your Majesty's transforming influence, and the urging and reward of my lord the Grand General Cheng."

units.zh: 世宗退謂暹曰：「我尚畏羨，何況餘人。」
units.en: Gao Cheng withdrew and said to Xian, "I still fear those impeachments—how much more others."
units.literal: Gao Cheng withdrew and said to Xian: "I still fear those impeachments—how much more others."

units.zh: 由是威名日盛，內外莫不畏服。
units.en: Thereafter his awe-inspiring name grew daily; inside and outside all feared him and submitted.
units.literal: Thereafter his awe-inspiring name grew daily; inside and outside none did not fear and submit.

units.zh: 高祖崩，未發喪，世宗以暹為度支尚書，兼僕射，委以心腹之寄。
units.en: When Gao Huan died, before the mourning was announced, Gao Cheng made Xian Director of Revenue and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, entrusting him with confidential responsibilities.
units.literal: When Gao Huan died, before the mourning was announced, Gao Cheng made Xian Director of Revenue and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, entrusting him with confidential responsibilities.

units.zh: 暹憂國如家，以天下為己任。
units.en: Xian worried for the state as for his home, taking the realm as his charge.
units.literal: Xian worried for the state as for his home, taking the realm as his charge.

units.zh: 世宗車服過度，誅戮變常，言談進止，或有虧失，暹每厲色極言，世宗亦為之止。
units.en: Gao Cheng's carriages and dress exceeded measure, executions were irregular, and in speech and conduct there were sometimes faults; Xian each time spoke sternly and to the utmost, and Gao Cheng also stopped on his account.
units.literal: Gao Cheng's carriages and dress exceeded measure, executions were irregular, and in speech and conduct there were sometimes faults; Xian each time spoke sternly and to the utmost, and Gao Cheng also stopped on his account.

units.zh: 有囚數百，世宗盡欲誅之，每催文帳。
units.en: Several hundred prisoners—Gao Cheng wished to execute them all and daily pressed for the documents.
units.literal: Several hundred prisoners—Gao Cheng wished to execute them all and daily pressed for the documents.

units.zh: 暹故緩之，不以時進，世宗意釋，竟以獲免。
units.en: Xian deliberately delayed them and did not submit in time; Gao Cheng's intent relaxed and in the end they were spared.
units.literal: Xian deliberately delayed them and did not submit in time; Gao Cheng's intent relaxed and in the end they were spared.

units.zh: 自出身從官，常日晏乃歸。
units.en: From his first entry into office he normally returned only at day's end.
units.literal: From his first entry into office he normally returned only at day's end.

units.zh: 侵曉則與兄弟問母之起居，暮則嘗食視寢，然後至外齋對親賓。
units.en: At dawn he and his brothers would ask after their mother's health; at evening he would taste food and look in on her sleep, then go to the outer study to face kin and guests.
units.literal: At dawn he and his brothers would ask after their mother's health; at evening he would taste food and look in on her sleep, then go to the outer study to face kin and guests.

units.zh: 一生不問家事。
units.en: In a lifetime he did not inquire into household affairs.
units.literal: In a lifetime he did not inquire into household affairs.

units.zh: 魏、梁通和，要貴皆遣人隨聘使交易，暹惟寄求佛經。
units.en: When Wei and Liang made peace, the great and favored all sent men with the envoys to trade; Xian only asked that Buddhist sutras be sent.
units.literal: When Wei and Liang made peace, the great and favored all sent men with the envoys to trade; Xian only asked that Buddhist sutras be sent.

units.zh: 梁武帝聞之，為繕寫，以幡花寶蓋贊唄送至館焉。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Liang heard of it, had them copied, and sent them to the lodge with streamers, flowers, precious canopies, hymns, and chants.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang heard of it, had them copied, and sent them to the lodge with streamers, flowers, precious canopies, hymns, and chants.

units.zh: 然而好大言，調戲無節。
units.en: Yet he loved grand talk and joking without restraint.
units.literal: Yet he loved grand talk and joking without restraint.

units.zh: 密令沙門明藏著《佛性論》而署己名，傳諸江表。
units.en: He secretly had the monk Mingzang compose the Treatise on Buddha-nature and affix his own name, transmitting it throughout the Jiang region.
units.literal: He secretly had the monk Mingzang compose the Treatise on Buddha-nature and affix his own name, transmitting it throughout the Jiang region.

units.zh: 子達拏年十三，暹命儒者權會教其說《周易》兩字，乃集朝貴名流，令達拏升高座開講。
units.en: His son Dana was thirteen; Xian had a Confucian named Quan Hui teach him to speak two words on the Book of Changes, then gathered court nobles and famous men and had Dana ascend the high seat to open a lecture.
units.literal: His son Dana was thirteen; Xian had a Confucian named Quan Hui teach him to speak two words on the Book of Changes, then gathered court nobles and famous men and had Dana ascend the high seat to open a lecture.

units.zh: 趙郡睦仲讓陽屈服之，暹喜，擢為司徒中郎。
units.en: Mu Zhongrang of Zhao commandery was made to yield on the spot; Xian was pleased and promoted him to gentleman of the secretariat.
units.literal: Mu Zhongrang of Zhao commandery was made to yield on the spot; Xian was pleased and promoted him to gentleman of the secretariat.

units.zh: 鄴下為之語曰：「講義兩行得中郎。」
units.en: Ye had a saying, "Two lines of lecture win a gentleman of the secretariat."
units.literal: Ye had a saying: "Two lines of lecture win a gentleman of the secretariat."

units.zh: 此皆暹之短也。
units.en: These were all Xian's failings.
units.literal: These were all Xian's failings.

units.zh: 顯祖初嗣霸業，司馬子如等挾舊怨，言暹罪重，謂宜罰之。
units.en: When Gao Yang first succeeded to the hegemony, Sima Ziru and others, nursing old grudges, said Xian's crimes were heavy and that he ought to be punished.
units.literal: When Gao Yang first succeeded to the hegemony, Sima Ziru and others, nursing old grudges, said Xian's crimes were heavy and that he ought to be punished.

units.zh: 高隆之亦言宜寬政網，去苛察法官，黜崔暹，則得遠近人意。
units.en: Gao Longzhi also said the government net should be widened, harsh inspecting judges removed, and Cui Xian dismissed—then near and far would be satisfied.
units.literal: Gao Longzhi also said the government net should be widened, harsh inspecting judges removed, and Cui Xian dismissed—then near and far would be satisfied.

units.zh: 顯祖從之。
units.en: Gao Yang followed this.
units.literal: Gao Yang followed this.

units.zh: 及踐祚，譖毀之者猶不息。
units.en: When he took the throne, those who slandered him still did not cease.
units.literal: When he took the throne, those who slandered him still did not cease.

units.zh: 帝乃令都督陳山提等搜暹家，甚貧匱，唯得高祖、世宗與暹書千餘紙，多論軍中大事。
units.en: Gao Yang then had Commander Chen Shanti and others search Xian's house—it was very poor; only a thousand-odd pages of letters from Gao Huan and Gao Cheng to Xian, mostly discussing great military affairs.
units.literal: The emperor then had Commander Chen Shanti and others search Xian's house—it was very poor; only a thousand-odd pages of letters from Gao Huan and Gao Cheng to Xian, mostly discussing great military affairs.

units.zh: 帝嗟賞之。
units.en: Gao Yang sighed in admiration.
units.literal: The emperor sighed in admiration.

units.zh: 仍不免衆口，乃流暹於馬城，晝則負土供役，夜則置地牢。
units.en: Still he could not silence everyone's mouths; he exiled Xian to Macheng—by day he carried earth for corvée, by night he was shut in a dungeon.
units.literal: Still he could not silence everyone's mouths; he exiled Xian to Macheng—by day he carried earth for corvée, by night he was shut in a dungeon.

units.zh: 歲餘，奴告暹謀反，鎖赴晉陽，無實，釋而勞之。
units.en: After more than a year, a slave reported Xian plotted rebellion; he was chained and taken to Jinyang—without substance; he was released and comforted.
units.literal: After more than a year, a slave reported Xian plotted rebellion; he was chained and taken to Jinyang—without substance; he was released and comforted.

units.zh: 尋遷太常卿。
units.en: Soon he was moved to grand minister of ceremonial.
units.literal: Soon he was moved to grand minister of ceremonial.

units.zh: 帝謂羣臣曰：「崔太常清正，天下無雙，卿等不及。」
units.en: Gao Yang said to the assembled ministers, "Grand Minister of Ceremonial Cui is pure and upright, without peer under heaven—you do not equal him."
units.literal: The emperor said to the assembled ministers: "Grand Minister of Ceremonial Cui is pure and upright, without peer under heaven—you do not equal him."

units.zh: 初，世宗欲以妹嫁暹子，而會世宗崩，遂寢。
units.en: Earlier, Gao Cheng had wished to marry his sister to Xian's son, but when Gao Cheng died the matter was dropped.
units.literal: Earlier, Gao Cheng had wished to marry his sister to Xian's son, but when Gao Cheng died the matter was dropped.

units.zh: 至是，羣臣宴於宣光殿，貴戚之子多在焉。
units.en: At this time the ministers feasted in Xuanguang Hall; many sons of noble kin were there.
units.literal: At this time the ministers feasted in Xuanguang Hall; many sons of noble kin were there.

units.zh: 顯祖歷與之語，於坐上親作書與暹曰：「賢子達拏，甚有才學。
units.en: Gao Yang went round speaking with them; at the seat he personally wrote to Xian, "Your worthy son Dana is very talented in learning.
units.literal: Gao Yang went round speaking with them; at the seat he personally wrote to Xian: "Your worthy son Dana is very talented in learning.

units.zh: 亡兄女樂安主，魏帝外甥，內外敬待，勝朕諸妹，思成大兄宿志。」
units.en: My late elder brother's daughter, Princess Le'an, the Wei emperor's niece, honored inside and outside, surpasses my sisters—I think to fulfill my elder brother's longstanding wish."
units.literal: My late elder brother's daughter, Princess Le'an, the Wei emperor's niece, honored inside and outside, surpasses my sisters—I think to fulfill my elder brother's longstanding wish."

units.zh: 乃以主降達拏。
units.en: He then gave the princess to Dana in marriage.
units.literal: He then gave the princess to Dana in marriage.

units.zh: 天保末，為右僕射。
units.en: At the end of Tianbao he was right vice director.
units.literal: At the end of Tianbao he was right vice director.

units.zh: 帝謂左右曰：「崔暹諫我飲酒過多，然我飲何所妨？」
units.en: Gao Yang said to those about him, "Cui Xian admonishes me for drinking too much—but what harm is my drinking?"
units.literal: The emperor said to those about him: "Cui Xian admonishes me for drinking too much—but what harm is my drinking?"

units.zh: 常山王私謂暹曰：「至尊或多醉，太后尚不能致言，吾兄弟杜口，僕射獨能犯顏，內外深相感愧。」
units.en: Prince of Changshan said privately to Xian, "The Supreme One may often be drunk; the empress dowager cannot yet speak up; we brothers hold our tongues—only you, vice director, dare to offend his countenance; inside and outside we are deeply moved and ashamed."
units.literal: Prince of Changshan said privately to Xian: "The Supreme One may often be drunk; the empress dowager cannot yet speak up; we brothers hold our tongues—only you, vice director, dare to offend his countenance; inside and outside we are deeply moved and ashamed."

units.zh: 十年，暹以疾卒，帝撫靈而哭。
units.en: In the tenth year Xian died of illness; Gao Yang stroked the bier and wept.
units.literal: In the tenth year Xian died of illness; the emperor stroked the bier and wept.

units.zh: 贈開府。
units.en: He was posthumously enfeoffed as grand marshalate.
units.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as grand marshalate.

units.zh: 達拏溫良清謹，有識學，少歷職為司農卿。
units.en: Dana was gentle, good, pure, and careful, with knowledge and learning; in youth he held office as minister of the state granaries.
units.literal: Dana was gentle, good, pure, and careful, with knowledge and learning; in youth he held office as minister of the state granaries.

units.zh: 入周，謀反伏誅。
units.en: After entering Zhou he plotted rebellion and was executed.
units.literal: After entering Zhou he plotted rebellion and was executed.

units.zh: 天保時，顯祖嘗問樂安公主：「達拏於汝何似？」
units.en: In the Tianbao era Gao Yang once asked Princess Le'an, "How does Dana compare with you?"
units.literal: In the Tianbao era Gao Yang once asked Princess Le'an: "How does Dana compare with you?"

units.zh: 答曰：「甚相敬重，唯阿家憎兒。」
units.en: She answered, "We greatly respect each other—only Mother-in-law hates the boy."
units.literal: She answered: "We greatly respect each other—only Mother-in-law hates the boy."

units.zh: 顯祖召達拏母入內，殺之，投屍漳水。
units.en: Gao Yang summoned Dana's mother into the palace, killed her, and threw the body into the Zhang River.
units.literal: Gao Yang summoned Dana's mother into the palace, killed her, and threw the body into the Zhang River.

units.zh: 齊滅，達拏殺主以復讐。
units.en: When Qi was destroyed, Dana killed the princess to avenge his mother.
units.literal: When Qi was destroyed, Dana killed the princess to avenge his mother.

units.zh: 高德政，字士貞，渤海蓚人。
units.en: Gao Dezheng, styled Shizhen, was a man of Su in Bohai.
units.literal: Gao Dezheng, styled Shizhen, was a man of Su in Bohai.

units.zh: 父顥，魏滄州刺史。
units.en: His father Hao was Wei inspector of Cangzhou.
units.literal: His father Hao was Wei inspector of Cangzhou.

units.zh: 德政幼而敏慧，有風神儀表。
units.en: Dezheng was clever and keen in youth, with spirit and dignified bearing.
units.literal: Dezheng was clever and keen in youth, with spirit and dignified bearing.

units.zh: 顯祖引為開府參軍，知管記事，甚相親狎。
units.en: Gao Yang brought him in as staff officer to the grand marshalate in charge of records, and was very intimate.
units.literal: Gao Yang brought him in as staff officer to the grand marshalate in charge of records, and was very intimate.

units.zh: 高祖又擢為相府掾，委以腹心。
units.en: Gao Huan also promoted him as staff officer to the chancellor's residence, entrusting him as confidant.
units.literal: Gao Huan also promoted him as staff officer to the chancellor's residence, entrusting him as confidant.

units.zh: 遷黃門侍郎。
units.en: He was moved to gentleman of the yellow gates.
units.literal: He was moved to gentleman of the yellow gates.

units.zh: 世宗嗣業，如晉陽，顯祖在京居守，令德政參掌機密，彌見親重。
units.en: Gao Cheng succeeded to the enterprise and went to Jinyang; Gao Yang remained in the capital as defender and had Dezheng share in secret affairs, and favor grew still greater.
units.literal: Gao Cheng succeeded to the enterprise; he went to Jinyang; Gao Yang remained in the capital as defender; he had Dezheng share in secret affairs, and favor grew still greater.

units.zh: 世宗暴崩，事出倉卒，羣情草草。
units.en: Gao Cheng died suddenly; affairs came in haste and the mood of the masses was disorderly.
units.literal: Gao Cheng died suddenly; affairs came in haste and the mood of the masses was disorderly.

units.zh: 勳將等以纘戎事重，勸帝早赴晉陽。
units.en: The meritorious generals held that continuing the military enterprise was weighty and urged Gao Yang to go quickly to Jinyang.
units.literal: The meritorious generals held that continuing the military enterprise was weighty and urged the emperor to go quickly to Jinyang.

units.zh: 帝亦回遑不能自決，夜中召楊愔、杜弼、崔季舒及德政等，始定策焉。
units.en: Gao Yang also hesitated and could not decide; in the night he summoned Yang Yin, Du Bi, Cui Jishu, Dezheng, and others, and only then settled the plan.
units.literal: The emperor also hesitated and could not decide; in the night he summoned Yang Yin, Du Bi, Cui Jishu, and Dezheng and others, and only then settled the plan.

units.zh: 以楊愔居守。
units.en: Yang Yin was left to hold the capital.
units.literal: Yang Yin was left to hold the capital.

units.zh: 德政與帝舊相昵愛，言無不盡。
units.en: Dezheng and Gao Yang had long been intimate and affectionate; in speech nothing was withheld.
units.literal: Dezheng and the emperor had long been intimate and affectionate; in speech nothing was withheld.

units.zh: 散騎常侍徐之才、館客宋景業先為天文圖讖之學，又陳山提家客楊子術有所援引，並因德政勸顯祖行禪代之事。
units.en: Regular attendant Xu Zhicai and retainer Song Jingye were versed first in astronomy and apocrypha; also Chen Shanti's household retainer Yang Zishu had connections—all through Dezheng urged Gao Yang to carry out the abdication and succession.
units.literal: Regular attendant Xu Zhicai and retainer Song Jingye were versed first in astronomy and apocrypha; also Chen Shanti's household retainer Yang Zishu had connections—all through Dezheng urged Gao Yang to carry out the abdication and succession.

units.zh: 德政又披心固請。
units.en: Dezheng again laid bare his heart and pressed the matter without relenting.
units.literal: Dezheng again poured out his heart and firmly pressed the request.

units.zh: 帝乃手書與楊愔，具論諸人勸進意。
units.en: Gao Yang then wrote in his own hand to Yang Yin, explaining in full how the others meant to urge him onto the throne.
units.literal: The emperor then wrote in his own hand to Yang Yin, setting forth in full the men's intent in urging accession.

units.zh: 德政恐愔猶豫不決，自請馳驛赴京，託以餘事，唯與楊愔言，愔方相應和。
units.en: Dezheng feared Yin would still waver; he asked to ride post-haste to the capital on a pretext of other business and spoke with Yin alone — and Yin at last fell in with him.
units.literal: Dezheng feared Yin would still hesitate and not decide; he asked leave to ride post-haste to the capital on other business as a pretext, speaking only with Yang Yin — and Yin at last echoed him.

units.zh: 德政還未至，帝便發晉陽，至平城都，召諸勳將入，告以禪讓之事。
units.en: Before Dezheng returned, Gao Yang had already left Jinyang, reached the fortress at Pingcheng, summoned the meritorious generals, and told them of the abdication.
units.literal: Before Dezheng could return, the emperor had already set out from Jinyang, reached the fortress at Pingcheng, summoned the meritorious generals in, and told them of the abdication.

units.zh: 諸將等忽聞，皆愕然，莫敢答者。
units.en: The generals heard it all at once and stood stunned; none dared speak.
units.literal: The generals heard it suddenly; all were stunned, and none dared answer.

units.zh: 時杜弼為長史，密啟顯祖云：「關西是國家勁敵，若今受魏禪，恐其稱義兵挾天子而東向，王將何以待之？」
units.en: Du Bi was chief clerk at the time; he secretly reported to Gao Yang, "Guanxi is the state's hard enemy. If you accept Wei's abdication now, I fear they will call it a righteous army, take the Son of Heaven in hand, and march east — how will you meet them?"
units.literal: At the time Du Bi was chief clerk; he secretly reported to Gao Yang: "Guanxi is the state's formidable foe. If you now accept Wei's abdication, I fear they will raise a righteous army, take the Son of Heaven in hand, and march east — how will Your Highness meet them?"

units.zh: 顯祖入，召弼入與徐之才相告。
units.en: Gao Yang went in and summoned Bi to tell Xu Zhicai together.
units.literal: Gao Yang entered and summoned Bi in to tell Xu Zhicai together.

units.zh: 之才云：「今與王爭天下者，彼意亦欲為帝，譬如逐兔滿市，一人得之，衆心皆定。
units.en: Xu Zhicai said, "Whoever contends with you for the realm today wants to be emperor too — like chasing a rabbit through a crowded market: once one man catches it, every heart settles.
units.literal: Xu Zhicai said: "He who contends with you for the realm today likewise means to become emperor — like chasing a rabbit through a crowded market: once one man catches it, every heart is settled.

units.zh: 今若先受魏禪，關西自應息心。
units.en: Accept Wei's abdication first and Guanxi should quiet of itself.
units.literal: If you accept Wei's abdication first, Guanxi should of itself quiet its heart.

units.zh: 縱欲屈強，止當逐我稱帝。
units.en: Even if they mean to force the issue, at most they will chase us in declaring themselves emperor.
units.literal: Even if they wish to bend their strength against us, at most they will chase us in proclaiming emperorship.

units.zh: 必宜知機先覺，無容後以學人。」
units.en: You must know the moment and move first — no learning from others after the fact."
units.literal: You must seize the moment and be first to perceive the chance — no room to learn from others afterward."

units.zh: 弼無以答。
units.en: Bi had nothing to say.
units.literal: Bi had nothing to answer.

units.zh: 帝已遣馳驛向鄴，書與太尉高岳、尚書令高隆之、領軍婁睿、侍中張亮、黃門趙彥深、楊愔等。
units.en: Gao Yang had already sent post-horses toward Ye with letters to Grand Commandant Gao Yue, Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Longzhi, army supervisor Lou Rui, palace attendant Zhang Liang, yellow gate Zhao Yanshen, Yang Yin, and the rest.
units.literal: The emperor had already sent post-horses toward Ye with letters to Grand Commandant Gao Yue, Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Longzhi, Army Supervisor Lou Rui, Palace Attendant Zhang Liang, Yellow Gate Zhao Yanshen, Yang Yin, and others.

units.zh: 岳等馳傳至高陽驛，帝使約曰：「知諸貴等意，不須來。」
units.en: Yue and the others rode express to the Gaoyang post-station; Gao Yang sent word, "I know what you nobles intend — you need not come."
units.literal: Yue and the others rode express to the Gaoyang post-station; the emperor sent word: "I know what you nobles intend — no need to come."

units.zh: 唯楊愔見，高岳等並還。
units.en: Only Yang Yin was received; Gao Yue and the others all turned back.
units.literal: Only Yang Yin was received; Gao Yue and the rest all returned.

units.zh: 帝以衆人意未協，又先得太后旨云：「汝父如龍，汝兄如虎，尚以人臣終，汝何容欲行舜、禹事？
units.en: Because the men's hearts were not yet one, Gao Yang had also received the empress dowager's word earlier: "Your father was like a dragon and your brother like a tiger, yet both died as subjects — how can you think to play Yao and Shun?
units.literal: The emperor, because the men's hearts were not yet aligned, had also earlier received the empress dowager's charge: "Your father was like a dragon, your brother like a tiger — and both ended as subjects. How can you think to play Yao and Shun?

units.zh: 此亦非汝意，正是高德政教汝。」
units.en: This is not your thought either; it is Gao Dezheng teaching you."
units.literal: This is not your own thought either; it is Gao Dezheng who is teaching you."

units.zh: 又說者以為昔周武王再駕盟津，然始革命，於是乃旋晉陽。
units.en: Others said that in old times King Wu of Zhou crossed the Meng Ford twice before he began the revolution — and so he turned back to Jinyang.
units.literal: Others also urged that in old times King Wu of Zhou crossed the Meng Ford twice before he began the revolution — and so he turned back to Jinyang.

units.zh: 自是居常不悅。
units.en: From then on he was often ill at ease.
units.literal: From then on he was habitually displeased.

units.zh: 徐之才、宋景業等每言卜筮雜占陰陽緯侯，必宜五月應天順人，德政亦勸不已。
units.en: Xu Zhicai, Song Jingye, and others kept speaking of divination, mixed auguries, yin and yang, and omens in the weft-texts — that May was the time to answer Heaven and win men; Dezheng urged on without pause.
units.literal: Xu Zhicai, Song Jingye, and others constantly spoke of divination, miscellaneous auguries, yin and yang, and the weft-texts of omens — that May was surely the time to answer Heaven and accord with men; Dezheng too urged without cease.

units.zh: 仍白帝追魏收。
units.en: They also reported to Gao Yang to recall Wei Shou.
units.literal: They also reported to the emperor to summon Wei Shou back.

units.zh: 收至，令撰禪讓詔册、九錫建臺及勸進文表。
units.en: When Shou arrived, he was ordered to draft the abdication edicts and registers, the Nine Bestowals, the founding terrace, and the memorials urging accession.
units.literal: When Shou arrived, he was ordered to draft the abdication edicts and proclamations, the Nine Bestowals, establishment of the terrace, and the memorial tables urging accession.

units.zh: 至五月初，帝發晉陽。
units.en: At the start of the fifth month Gao Yang left Jinyang.
units.literal: When the fifth month began, the emperor set out from Jinyang.

units.zh: 德政又錄在鄴諸事條進於帝，帝令陳山提馳驛賫事條並密書與楊愔。
units.en: Dezheng also compiled the items of business at Ye and presented them to Gao Yang; Gao Yang had Chen Shanti ride post-haste with the list and a secret letter to Yang Yin.
units.literal: Dezheng also compiled a list of matters at Ye and presented it to the emperor; the emperor had Chen Shanti ride post-haste with the list and a secret letter to Yang Yin.

units.zh: 大略令撰儀註，防察魏室諸王。
units.en: In outline he was to draft ritual regulations and keep watch on the princes of Wei.
units.literal: In outline he was to draft ritual regulations and keep watch on the princes of the Wei house.

units.zh: 山提以五月至鄴，楊愔卽召太常卿邢卲、七兵尚書崔㥄悛、度支尚書陸操、詹事王昕、黃門侍郎陽休之、中書侍郎裴讓之等議撰儀注。
units.en: Shanti reached Ye in the fifth month; Yang Yin at once summoned director of ceremonies Xing Shao, minister of the seven armies Cui Lingjun, minister of revenue Lu Cao, household mentor Wang Xin, yellow gate attendant Yang Xiuzhi, secretariat gentleman Pei Rangzhi, and others to draft the ritual regulations.
units.literal: Shanti reached Ye in the fifth month; Yang Yin at once summoned Director of Ceremonies Xing Shao, Minister of the Seven Armies Cui Lingjun, Minister of Revenue Lu Cao, Household Mentor Wang Xin, Yellow Gate Attendant Yang Xiuzhi, Secretariat Gentleman Pei Rangzhi, and others to deliberate on drafting the ritual regulations.

units.zh: 六日，要魏太傅咸陽王坦等總集，引人北宮，留于東齋，受禪後，乃放還宅。
units.en: On the sixth day he required Wei grand tutor Prince of Xianyang Tan and the rest to assemble, brought them into the Northern Palace, and kept them in the eastern study — only after the abdication were they released to their homes.
units.literal: On the sixth day he required Wei Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang Wang Tan and others to assemble in full, brought them into the Northern Palace, and kept them in the eastern study — after the abdication they were only then released to their residences.

units.zh: 帝初發至亭前，所乘馬忽倒，意甚惡之，大以沉吟。
units.en: When Gao Yang first set out and reached the pavilion front, his mount suddenly fell — he took it as a very ill omen and brooded long.
units.literal: When the emperor first set out and reached the pavilion front, the horse he rode suddenly fell — he took it as a very bad sign and pondered long.

units.zh: 至平城都，便不復肯進。
units.en: At the fortress of Pingcheng he would go no farther.
units.literal: Reaching the fortress at Pingcheng, he would advance no further.

units.zh: 德政、徐之才苦請帝曰：「山提先去，若為形容，恐其漏泄不果。」
units.en: Dezheng and Xu Zhicai pressed Gao Yang hard: "Shanti went ahead — if appearances give it away, I fear the leak will ruin everything."
units.literal: Dezheng and Xu Zhicai bitterly begged the emperor: "Shanti went ahead — if word gets out through how things look, I fear the leak will undo the affair."

units.zh: 卽命司馬子如、杜弼馳驛續入，觀察物情。
units.en: He then ordered Sima Ziru and Du Bi to ride post-haste after them and read the mood of the crowd.
units.literal: He then ordered Sima Ziru and Du Bi to ride post-haste and follow in, to observe how men felt.

units.zh: 七日，子如等至鄴，衆人以事勢已決，無敢異言。
units.en: On the seventh day Ziru and the others reached Ye; seeing the affair already settled, none dared speak against it.
units.literal: On the seventh day Ziru and the others reached Ye; the crowd, seeing the affair already settled, dared voice no dissent.

units.zh: 八日，楊愔書中旨，以魏襄城王旭並司空公潘相樂、侍中張亮、黃門趙彥深入通奏事。
units.en: On the eighth day Yang Yin wrote the central order, sending Wei Prince of Xiangcheng Xu with grand master of ceremonies Pan Xiangyue, palace attendant Zhang Liang, and yellow gate Zhao Yanshen to report at court.
units.literal: On the eighth day Yang Yin wrote the central order, sending Wei Prince of Xiangcheng Wang Xu together with Grand Master of Ceremonies Pan Xiangyue, Palace Attendant Zhang Liang, and Yellow Gate Zhao Yanshen to communicate matters at court.

units.zh: 魏孝靜在昭陽殿引見。
units.en: Emperor Xiaojing of Wei received them in the Zhaoyang Hall.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaojing of Wei received them at the Zhaoyang Hall.

units.zh: 旭云：「五行遞運，有始有終，齊王聖德欽明，萬方歸仰，臣等昧死聞奏，願陛下則堯禪舜。」
units.en: Xu said, "The Five Agents turn in succession — all things have beginning and end. The Prince of Qi's sacred virtue is bright; the ten thousand regions look to him. We risk death to report: we pray Your Majesty will follow Yao in yielding to Shun."
units.literal: Xu said: "The Five Agents move in succession — there is beginning and end. The Prince of Qi's sacred virtue is revered and bright; the ten thousand regions turn to him in homage. We, your servants, risk death to report: we pray Your Majesty will follow Yao in yielding to Shun."

units.zh: 魏帝便斂容曰：「此事推挹已久，謹當遜避。」
units.en: The Wei emperor composed himself and said, "This has long been pressed upon me — I shall respectfully yield."
units.literal: The Wei emperor drew himself up and said: "This matter has long been pressed upon me — I shall respectfully yield and withdraw."

units.zh: 又道：「若爾，須作詔。」
units.en: He added, "If so, an edict must be made."
units.literal: He added: "If so, an edict must be drafted."

units.zh: 中書侍郎崔劼奏云：「詔已作訖。」
units.en: Secretariat gentleman Cui Jie reported, "The edict is already done."
units.literal: Secretariat Gentleman Cui Jie reported: "The edict is already finished."

units.zh: 卽付楊愔進於魏靜帝。
units.en: It was at once given to Yang Yin to present to Emperor Jing of Wei.
units.literal: It was at once handed to Yang Yin to present to Emperor Jing of Wei.

units.zh: 凡有十餘條，悉書。
units.en: There were more than ten articles in all, each written out.
units.literal: There were more than ten articles in all, all written out.

units.zh: 魏靜云：「安置朕何所，復若為去？」
units.en: Emperor Jing said, "Where will you lodge me — and how am I to leave?"
units.literal: Emperor Jing said: "Where will you place me — and how am I to go?"

units.zh: 楊愔對：「在北城別有館宇，還備法駕，依常仗衛而去。」
units.en: Yang Yin replied, "In the northern city there is a separate lodge; the imperial equipage will be prepared, and you will go with the usual guards and escort."
units.literal: Yang Yin replied: "In the northern city there is a separate lodge; the imperial equipage will be made ready, and you will go with the usual guards and escort."

units.zh: 魏靜帝於是下御坐，就東廊，口詠範蔚宗《後漢書贊》云：「獻生不辰，身播國屯，終我四百，永作虞賓。」
units.en: Emperor Jing of Wei stepped down from the throne, went to the eastern gallery, and recited Fan Ye's encomium from the History of Later Han: "Xian was born untimely, his person cast upon the state's ordeal — ending our four hundred years, forever guest of Yu."
units.literal: Emperor Jing of Wei thereupon stepped down from the imperial seat, went to the eastern gallery, and intoned Fan Ye's encomium from the History of Later Han: "The Emperor Xian was born untimely, his person cast upon the state's ordeal — ending our four hundred years, forever to be guest of Yu."

units.zh: 所司尋奏請發。
units.en: The responsible office soon memorialized asking that he depart.
units.literal: The responsible office soon memorialized requesting departure.

units.zh: 魏靜帝曰：「人念遺簪弊屨，欲與六宮別，可乎？」
units.en: Emperor Jing said, "Men cherish even a lost hairpin or worn shoes — may I bid farewell to the six palaces?"
units.literal: Emperor Jing said: "Men recall even a lost hairpin or worn-out shoes — may I take leave of the six palaces?"

units.zh: 乃入與夫人嬪御以下訣別，莫不歔欷掩涕。
units.en: He went in to take leave of the ladies, consorts, attendants, and those below — none without weeping and covering their faces.
units.literal: He then went in to bid farewell to the ladies, consorts, attendants, and those below — none without sobbing and covering their tears.

units.zh: 嬪趙國李氏口誦陳思王詩云：「王其愛玉體，俱享黃髮期。」
units.en: Lady Li of Zhao recited Prince Si of Chen's lines: "My lord, cherish your jade body — may we together reach the years of yellow hair."
units.literal: Lady Li of Zhao recited Prince Si of Chen's poem: "My lord, cherish your jade body — may we together enjoy the years of yellow hair."

units.zh: 魏靜帝登車出萬春門，直長趙道德在車中陪侍，百官在門外拜辭。
units.en: Emperor Jing mounted his carriage and went out the Wanchun Gate; chief controller Zhao Daode attended him in the carriage; the hundred officials bowed farewell outside the gate.
units.literal: Emperor Jing mounted his carriage and went out through the Wanchun Gate; chief controller Zhao Daode attended him in the carriage; the hundred officials bowed farewell outside the gate.

units.zh: 遂入北城下司馬子如南宅。
units.en: He entered the northern city and lodged at Sima Ziru's southern residence.
units.literal: He then entered the northern city and lodged at Sima Ziru's southern residence.

units.zh: 帝至城南頓所。
units.en: Gao Yang reached the halt south of the city.
units.literal: The emperor reached the halt at the south of the city.

units.zh: 受禪之日，除德政為侍中，尋封藍田公。
units.en: On the day the mandate was received, Dezheng was made palace attendant; soon after he was enfeoffed as duke of Lantian.
units.literal: On the day the mandate was received, Dezheng was appointed palace attendant; soon after he was enfeoffed as Duke of Lantian.

units.zh: 七年，遷尚書右僕射，兼侍中，食渤海郡幹。
units.en: In the seventh year he was moved to right vice director of the Masters of Writing, concurrently palace attendant, with income from Bohai commandery.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was moved to right vice director of the Masters of Writing, concurrently palace attendant, with a territorial income from Bohai commandery.

units.zh: 德政與尚書令楊愔綱紀政事，多有弘益。
units.en: Dezheng and Director Yang Yin set the order of government; they brought much that profited the realm.
units.literal: Dezheng with Director Yang Yin regulated state affairs; they brought many broad benefits.

units.zh: 顯祖末年，縱酒酣醉，所為不法，德政屢進忠言。
units.en: In Gao Yang's later years he drank deep and long; his acts broke the law — Dezheng remonstrated again and again.
units.literal: In Gao Yang's later years he drank freely and to drunkenness; his acts were lawless — Dezheng repeatedly offered loyal words.

units.zh: 後召德政飲，不從，又進言於前，諫曰：「陛下道我尋休，今乃甚於旣往，其若社稷何，其若太后何！」
units.en: Later he summoned Dezheng to drink; Dezheng refused and spoke before him again: "Your Majesty said I would soon rest — yet now you go further than before. What of the altars? What of the empress dowager!"
units.literal: Later he summoned Dezheng to drink; Dezheng would not obey and again spoke before him in remonstrance: "Your Majesty said I would soon rest — yet now you go further than before. What of the altars of soil and grain? What of the empress dowager!"

units.zh: 帝不悅。
units.en: Gao Yang was displeased.
units.literal: The emperor was displeased.

units.zh: 又謂左右云：「高德政恒以精神淩逼人。」
units.en: He also told those at his side, "Gao Dezheng always uses his spirit to overawe people."
units.literal: He also told those at his side: "Gao Dezheng always uses his spirit to overawe people."

units.zh: 德政甚懼，乃稱疾屏居佛寺，兼學坐禪，為退身之計。
units.en: Dezheng was deeply afraid; he claimed illness and withdrew to a Buddhist temple, also learning seated meditation — a plan to step back.
units.literal: Dezheng was greatly afraid; he claimed illness and withdrew to live secluded in a Buddhist temple, also learning seated meditation — a plan to draw back from office.

units.zh: 帝謂楊愔曰：「我大憂德政，其病何似？」
units.en: Gao Yang said to Yang Yin, "I am deeply worried about Dezheng — how is his illness?"
units.literal: The emperor said to Yang Yin: "I am deeply worried about Dezheng — how is his illness?"

units.zh: 愔以禪代之際，因德政言情切至，方致誠款，常內忌之。
units.en: Yin, because at the abdication Dezheng had spoken with such piercing force that Gao Yang gave him full sincerity, inwardly always resented him.
units.literal: Yin, because at the time of the abdication Dezheng had spoken with such piercing feeling that the emperor gave full sincerity — inwardly always resented him for it.

units.zh: 由是答云：「陛下若用作冀州刺史，病卽自差。」
units.en: He therefore answered, "If Your Majesty makes him inspector of Ji province, the illness will at once improve."
units.literal: He therefore answered: "If Your Majesty employs him as inspector of Ji province, the illness will at once improve."

units.zh: 帝從之，德政見除書而起。
units.en: Gao Yang agreed; Dezheng saw the appointment edict and rose.
units.literal: The emperor followed this; Dezheng saw the appointment edict and rose.

units.zh: 帝大怒，召德政謂之曰：「聞爾病，我為爾針。」
units.en: Gao Yang flew into a rage, summoned Dezheng, and said, "I heard you were ill — I have come to needle you myself."
units.literal: The emperor flew into a great rage, summoned Dezheng, and said to him: "I heard you were ill — I have come to needle you for you."

units.zh: 親以刀子刺之，血流沾地。
units.en: He stabbed him with a knife himself; blood ran and soaked the ground.
units.literal: He personally stabbed him with a knife; blood flowed and soaked the ground.

units.zh: 又使曳下，斬去其趾。
units.en: He also had him dragged down and his toes struck off.
units.literal: He also had him dragged down and his toes cut off.

units.zh: 劉桃枝捉刀不敢下。
units.en: Liu Taozhi took up the blade but dared not bring it down.
units.literal: Liu Taozhi took up the blade but dared not strike.

units.zh: 帝起臨階砌，切責桃枝曰：「爾頭卽墮地！」
units.en: Gao Yang rose to the stair treads and rebuked Taozhi sharply: "Your head will be next on the ground!"
units.literal: The emperor rose and stood on the stair treads, sharply rebuking Taozhi: "Your head will drop to the ground next!"

units.zh: 因索大刀自帶，欲下階。
units.en: He then demanded a great blade, girded it himself, and meant to come down the steps.
units.literal: He then demanded a great blade, girded it himself, and meant to come down the stairs.

units.zh: 桃枝乃斬足之三指。
units.en: Taozhi then cut off three of his toes.
units.literal: Taozhi then cut off three toes.

units.zh: 帝怒不解，禁德政於門下，其夜開城門，以氈輿送還家。
units.en: Gao Yang's rage did not ease; Dezheng was held at the Gate Department — that night the city gates were opened and he was sent home in a felt litter.
units.literal: The emperor's rage did not ease; Dezheng was held at the Gate Department — that night the city gates were opened and he was sent home in a felt litter.

units.zh: 旦日，德政妻出寶物滿四床，欲以寄人。
units.en: At dawn Dezheng's wife brought out treasures filling four couches, meaning to leave them with others for safekeeping.
units.literal: At dawn Dezheng's wife brought out treasures filling four couches, intending to leave them with others for safekeeping.

units.zh: 帝奄至其宅，見而怒曰：「我府藏猶無此物！」
units.en: Gao Yang came suddenly to the house, saw them, and said in anger, "My treasury does not even hold such things!"
units.literal: The emperor came suddenly to their house, saw them, and said in anger: "My treasury does not even have such things!"

units.zh: 詰其所從得，皆諸元賂之也。
units.en: He questioned where they came from — all were bribes from the various Yuan.
units.literal: He questioned where they came from — all were bribes from the various Yuan.

units.zh: 遂曳出斬之。
units.en: Dezheng was dragged out and beheaded.
units.literal: He was dragged out and beheaded.

units.zh: 時妻出拜，又斬之，並其子祭酒伯堅。
units.en: When his wife came out to bow, she was beheaded too, together with their son Bojian the libationer.
units.literal: When his wife came out to bow, she was beheaded too, together with their son Bojian, libationer.

units.zh: 德政死後，顯祖謂羣臣曰：「高德政常言宜用漢人，除鮮卑，此卽合死。
units.en: After Dezheng's death Gao Yang told the ministers, "Gao Dezheng always said one should employ Han men and remove the Xianbei — for that alone he deserved death.
units.literal: After Dezheng's death Gao Yang told the ministers: "Gao Dezheng always said one should employ Han men and remove the Xianbei — for that alone he deserved death.

units.zh: 又教我誅諸元，我今殺之，為諸元報讐也。」
units.en: He also urged me to execute the various Yuan — now that I have killed him, I have avenged the Yuan."
units.literal: He also urged me to execute the various Yuan — now that I have killed him, I have avenged the Yuan."

units.zh: 帝後悔，贈太保，嫡孫王臣襲焉。
units.en: Gao Yang later regretted it; Dezheng was posthumously made grand guardian; his eldest grandson Wangchen inherited the title.
units.literal: The emperor later regretted it; Dezheng was posthumously given Grand Guardian; his eldest grandson's son Wangchen inherited the title.

units.zh: 崔昂，字懷遠，博陵安平人也。
units.en: Cui Ang, styled Huaiyuan, was a man of Anping in Boling.
units.literal: Cui Ang, styled Huaiyuan, was a man of Anping in Boling.

units.zh: 祖挺，魏幽州刺史。
units.en: His grandfather Ting was Wei inspector of You province.
units.literal: His grandfather Ting was Wei inspector of You province.

units.zh: 昂年七歲而孤，伯父吏部尚書孝芬嘗謂所親曰：「此兒終當遠至，是吾家千里駒也。」
units.en: Ang was orphaned at seven; his father's elder brother, minister of personnel Xiaofen, once told those close to him, "This boy will go far in the end — he is our family's thousand-li colt."
units.literal: Ang was orphaned at seven; his father's elder brother, Minister of Personnel Xiaofen, once told those close to him: "This boy will in the end go far — he is our family's thousand-li colt."

units.zh: 昂性端直少華，沈深有志略，堅實難傾動。
units.en: Ang was upright and sparing of show, deep and steady in design — firm and hard to move.
units.literal: Ang's nature was upright with little ornament, deep and steady with design and stratagem — firm and hard to shake.

units.zh: 少好章句，頗綜文詞。
units.en: In youth he loved exegetical study and was fairly versed in literary phrasing.
units.literal: In youth he loved exegetical study and was fairly versed in literary phrasing.

units.zh: 世宗廣開幕府，引為記室參軍，委以腹心之任。
units.en: Gao Cheng broadly opened his headquarters and brought him in as Recorder and Staff Officer, entrusting him with confidential duties.
units.literal: Gao Cheng broadly opened his headquarters and brought him in as Recorder and Staff Officer, entrusting him with confidential duties.

units.zh: 世宗入輔朝政，召為開府長史。
units.en: When Gao Cheng entered to assist at court, he was summoned as chief clerk of the opening office.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng entered to assist court governance, he was summoned as chief clerk of the opening office.

units.zh: 時勳將親族兵客在都下放縱，多行不軌，孫騰、司馬子如之門尤劇。
units.en: At the time the meritorious generals' kin and military retainers in the capital ran wild, many acting outside the law — the households of Sun Teng and Sima Ziru were worst.
units.literal: At the time the meritorious generals' kin and military retainers in the capital ran wild, many acting outside the law — the households of Sun Teng and Sima Ziru were worst.

units.zh: 昂受世宗密旨，以法繩之，未幾之間，內外齊肅。
units.en: Ang received Gao Cheng's secret order and bound them with law; within no long time inner and outer were alike disciplined.
units.literal: Ang received Gao Cheng's secret order and bound them with law; within no long time inner and outer were alike disciplined.

units.zh: 遷尚書左丞，其年，又兼度支尚書。
units.en: He was moved to left assistant in the Masters of Writing; that same year he also held minister of revenue concurrently.
units.literal: He was moved to left assistant in the Masters of Writing; that same year he also held concurrently minister of revenue.

units.zh: 左丞之兼尚書，近代未有，唯昂獨為冠首，朝野榮之。
units.en: An assistant concurrently holding a ministry had not occurred in recent times — Ang alone was first; court and country honored him.
units.literal: An assistant concurrently holding a ministry post had not occurred in recent times — Ang alone was first; court and country honored him.

units.zh: 武定六年，甘露降於宮闕，文武官僚同賀顯陽殿。
units.en: In the sixth year of Wuding, sweet dew fell on the palace gates; civil and military officials together offered congratulations at the Xianyang Hall.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Wuding, sweet dew fell upon the palace gates; civil and military officials together offered congratulations at the Xianyang Hall.

units.zh: 魏帝問僕射崔暹、尚書楊愔等曰：「自古甘露之瑞，漢、魏多少，可各言往代所降之處，德化感致所由。」
units.en: The Wei emperor asked vice director Cui Xian, minister Yang Yin, and others, "Since antiquity the auspice of sweet dew — in Han and Wei, how often? Tell where it fell in past ages and by what moral transformation it was drawn down."
units.literal: The Wei emperor asked Vice Director Cui Xuan, Minister Yang Yin, and others: "Since antiquity the auspice of sweet dew — in Han and Wei, how many times? You may each tell where it fell in past ages and by what moral transformation it was drawn down."

units.zh: 次問昂，昂曰：「案《符瑞圖》，王者德致於天，則甘露降。
units.en: Ang was asked next; Ang said, "According to the Charts of Omens, when a king's virtue reaches Heaven, sweet dew descends.
units.literal: Ang was asked next; Ang said: "According to the Charts of Omens, when a king's virtue reaches Heaven, sweet dew descends.

units.zh: 吉凶兩門，不由符瑞，故桑雉為戒，實啟中興，小鳥孕大，未聞福感。
units.en: Good fortune and ill are two gates — they do not turn on omens. The mulberry cock was a warning yet truly opened restoration; a small bird bearing a great thing — I have not heard that called a blessing drawn down.
units.literal: Good fortune and ill are two gates — they do not depend on omens. Thus the mulberry cock was a warning yet truly opened restoration; a small bird bearing a great thing — I have not heard that called a blessing drawn down.

units.zh: 所願陛下雖休勿休。」
units.en: What I wish is that Your Majesty, though blessed with auspicious signs, not rest on them."
units.literal: What I wish is that Your Majesty, though at rest, never cease to rest."

units.zh: 帝為斂容曰：「朕旣無德，何以當此。」
units.en: The emperor composed himself and said, "I have no virtue — how could I deserve this?"
units.literal: The emperor drew himself up and said: "I have no virtue — how could I deserve this?"

units.zh: 齊受禪，遷散騎常侍，兼太府卿、大司農卿。
units.en: When Qi received the mandate, Ang was moved to attendant cavalry and made concurrently grand steward and grand minister of agriculture.
units.literal: When Qi received the mandate, Ang was moved to attendant cavalry and made concurrently grand steward and grand minister of agriculture.

units.zh: 二寺所掌，世號繁劇，昂校理有術，下無奸偽，經手歷目，知無不為，朝廷歎其至公。
units.en: What the two offices controlled was known as vexingly heavy; Ang had method in auditing — below him there was no fraud; whatever passed his hands and eyes he knew and undertook; the court praised his utmost fairness.
units.literal: What the two offices controlled was known in the age as vexingly heavy; Ang had method in auditing — below him there was no fraud; whatever passed his hands and eyes, he knew and undertook; the court praised his utmost fairness.

units.zh: 又奏上橫市妄費事三百一十四條，詔下，依啟狀速議以聞。
units.en: He also memorialized three hundred fourteen items of wasteful spending at the cross-market; an edict went down to deliberate quickly on his memorial and report back.
units.literal: He also memorialized three hundred fourteen items of wasteful spending at the cross-market; an edict went down to deliberate quickly according to the memorial and report.

units.zh: 其年，與太子少師邢卲議定國初禮，仍封華陽縣男。
units.en: That year, with junior tutor Xing Shao, he fixed the rites at the dynasty's founding; he was then enfeoffed as baron of Huayang.
units.literal: That year, with Junior Tutor Xing Shao, he deliberated on the rites at the dynasty's founding; he was then enfeoffed as Baron of Huayang.

units.zh: 又詔刪定律令，損益禮樂，令尚書右僕射薛琡等四十三人在領軍府議定。
units.en: An edict also ordered revision of laws and statutes and changes in ritual and music — forty-three men including right vice director Xue Xu were charged to deliberate at the army supervisor headquarters.
units.literal: An edict also ordered revision of laws and statutes, addition and subtraction in ritual and music — forty-three men including Right Vice Director Xue Xu were charged to deliberate at the army supervisor headquarters.

units.zh: 又勑昂云：「若諸人不相遵納，卿可依事啟聞。」
units.en: He again ordered Ang, saying, "If the others will not obey and accept, report to me as the facts warrant."
units.literal: Again he ordered Ang, saying, "If the others do not comply and accept, you may report according to the matter."

units.zh: 昂奉勑笑曰：「正合生平之願。」
units.en: Ang took the order and laughed. "That is just what I have wished all my life."
units.literal: Ang received the order and laughed, saying, "This exactly matches my lifelong wish."

units.zh: 昂素勤慎，奉勑之後，彌自警勗，部分科條，校正今古，所增損十有七八。
units.en: Ang had always been diligent and careful. After the order he redoubled his watch on himself, set out the legal articles, and collated past and present usage — his additions and cuts came to seven or eight parts in ten.
units.literal: Ang had always been diligent and careful; after receiving the order he was all the more self-warned and exhorted himself, arranging the articles of law, collating ancient and modern — additions and deletions amounted to seven or eight tenths.

units.zh: 轉廷尉卿。
units.en: He was transferred to minister of justice.
units.literal: He was transferred to Director of Convicts.

units.zh: 昂本性清嚴，凡見黷貨輩，疾之若讐，以是治獄文深，世論不以平恕相許。
units.en: Ang was by nature austere and strict. Anyone he saw taking bribes he hated like an enemy; for that reason his judgments ran deep and hard, and public opinion did not credit him with fairness.
units.literal: Ang's nature was pure and stern; whenever he saw those who took bribes he hated them as enemies — hence his handling of cases ran deep in the law, and worldly opinion did not grant him even-handed lenience.

units.zh: 顯祖幸東山，百官預宴，升射堂。
units.en: Gao Yang visited Eastern Mountain. The hundred officials joined the feast and went up to the shooting hall.
units.literal: Xianzu visited Eastern Mountain; all officials attended the feast and ascended the shooting hall.

units.zh: 帝召昂於御坐前，謂曰：「舊人多出為州，我欲以臺閣中相付，當用卿為令仆，勿望刺史。
units.en: The emperor called Ang before the throne and said, "The old hands mostly go out to the provinces. I mean to put the terrace offices in your hands — you shall serve as director and vice director of the secretariat. Do not look for a provincial inspectorship.
units.literal: The emperor summoned Ang before the imperial seat and said, "Old men mostly go out as provincial governors; I wish to entrust matters within the terrace offices — I shall use you as director and vice director of the secretariat. Do not hope for an inspector's post.

units.zh: 卿六十外當與卿本州，中間州不可得也。」
units.en: After you pass sixty I will give you your home province. Between now and then you will not get one."
units.literal: After you turn sixty I shall give you your native province; in between you cannot have a province."

units.zh: 後九卿以上陪集東宮，帝指昂及尉瑾、司馬子瑞謂太子曰：「此是國家柱石，汝宜記之。」
units.en: Later, when the nine ministers and above attended the crown prince at the Eastern Palace, the emperor pointed to Ang, Wei Jin, and Sima Zirui and told the heir, "These are the state's pillars. Mark them well."
units.literal: Later, when the nine ministers and above gathered with the crown prince at the Eastern Palace, the emperor pointed to Ang, Wei Jin, and Sima Zirui and said to the crown prince, "These are the pillars of the state — you should remember them."

units.zh: 未幾，復侍宴金鳳臺，帝歷數諸人，咸有罪負，至昂曰：「崔昂直臣，魏收才士，婦兄妹夫，俱省罪過。」
units.en: Before long he again attended a feast at Golden Phoenix Terrace. The emperor went down the roster, charging each man with some fault, until he came to Ang and said, "Cui Ang is a straight minister; Wei Shou is a man of letters — brothers-in-law, both of you are excused."
units.literal: Before long he again attended a feast at Golden Phoenix Terrace; the emperor went through the men one by one — all had crimes and faults — until Ang, and said, "Cui Ang is a straight minister, Wei Shou a talented scholar — wife's brother and sister's husband — both are spared blame."

units.zh: 天保十年，策拜儀同燕子獻，百司陪列，昂在行中。
units.en: In the tenth year of Tianbao, at the ceremony investing Yan Zixian as equal in insignia with opening office, the hundred offices lined the route — Ang stood among them.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Tianbao, at the ceremony appointing Yan Zixian as equal in insignia with opening office, the hundred offices formed the escort — Ang was in the ranks.

units.zh: 帝特召昂至御所，曰：「歷思羣臣可綱紀省闥者，唯冀卿一人。」
units.en: The emperor called Ang alone to the throne room and said, "I have weighed every minister who could keep order in the secretariat. I rely on you alone."
units.literal: The emperor specially summoned Ang to the imperial place and said, "Having reviewed all the ministers who could keep order in the secretariat, I rely on you alone."

units.zh: 卽日除為兼右僕射。
units.en: That same day he was made acting right vice director of the secretariat.
units.literal: That same day he was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 數日後，昂因入奏事，帝謂尚書令楊愔曰：「昨不與崔昂正者，言其太速，欲明年真之。
units.en: A few days later Ang came in on business. The emperor said to Yang Yin, director of the secretariat, "Yesterday I did not give Cui Ang the full post — I said it was too soon and meant to make it formal next year.
units.literal: A few days later Ang came in to report affairs; the emperor said to Director of the Secretariat Yang Yin, "Yesterday I did not give Cui Ang the full appointment — I said it was too fast and intended to make it formal next year.

units.zh: 終是除正，何事早晚，可除正僕射。」
units.en: A full appointment is a full appointment — what does early or late matter? Give him the full vice directorship."
units.literal: In the end formal appointment is formal appointment — what does early or late matter? He may be given the full vice director post."

units.zh: 明日，卽拜為真。
units.en: The next day he was invested at once in the full rank.
units.literal: The next day Ang was immediately invested in the full post.

units.zh: 楊愔少時與昂不平，顯祖崩後，遂免昂僕射，除儀同三司。
units.en: Yang Yin had been at odds with Ang since they were young. After Gao Yang's death he stripped Ang of the vice directorship and made him equal in insignia to three departments.
units.literal: Yang Yin had been on bad terms with Ang since youth; after Xianzu's death he removed Ang from vice director and made him equal in insignia to three departments.

units.zh: 後坐事除名。
units.en: Later he was struck from the rolls for an offense.
units.literal: Later he was struck from the rolls for an offense.

units.zh: 卒祠部尚書。
units.en: He died as director of the office for sacrifices.
units.literal: He died as Director of the Office for Sacrifices.

units.zh: 昂有風調才識，舊立堅正剛直之名。
units.en: Ang had presence, talent, and judgment; he had long borne a name for firm, upright conduct.
units.literal: Ang had elegant bearing and talent with discernment; he had long established a name for firm uprightness and directness.

units.zh: 然好探揣上意，感激時主，或列陰私罪失，深為顯祖所知賞，發言獎護，人莫之能毀。
units.en: Yet he liked to read the ruler's mind and repay the favor of his times; he would sometimes set out men's hidden faults, and Gao Yang knew and prized this, speaking up to praise and shield him so that none could bring him down.
units.literal: Yet he liked to probe and gauge the ruler's intent, moved by gratitude to the times' lord; he would sometimes list private crimes and faults, deeply known and rewarded by Xianzu, who spoke to praise and shield him — none could bring him down.

units.zh: 議曹律令，京畿密獄，及朝廷之大事多委之。
units.en: Deliberations on law, the capital's secret prisons, and the weightiest court business were largely left to him.
units.literal: Council deliberations on laws and statutes, secret prisons of the capital region, and great affairs of court were largely entrusted to him.

units.zh: 尚嚴猛，好行鞭撻，雖苦楚萬端，對之自若。
units.en: He favored severity and the whip; though pain ran to every extremity, his face stayed calm.
units.literal: He prized severity and harshness, liked to apply the lash; though suffering was manifold, he faced it with composure.

units.zh: 前者崔暹、季舒為之親援，後乃高德政是其中表，常有挾恃，意色矜高，以此不為名流所服。
units.en: At first Cui Xian and Cui Jishu backed him closely; later his cousin Gao Dezheng was his patron. He always had someone behind him and carried himself high — for that the leading men did not respect him.
units.literal: At first Cui Xian and Ji Shu were his close backers; later Gao Dezheng was his cousin — he always had backing and his manner was proud and lofty, and for this the leading circles did not esteem him.

units.zh: 子液嗣。
units.en: His son Ye succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Ye succeeded.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 壬寅，魏帝詔太原公洋攝理軍國，遣中使敦喻。
units.en: On renyin day the emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang administer military and state affairs and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.
units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時太原公洋在城東雙堂，入而討賊，臠割京等，皆漆其頭。
units.en: At the time Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.
units.literal: At the time Prince of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.

units.zh: 丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。
units.en: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Zhao Yanshen was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Zhao Yanshen was appointed Left Deputy Director.

units.zh: 趙郡李公統預高歸彥之逆，其母崔氏卽御史中丞崔昂從父子，兼右僕射魏收之內妹也。
units.en: Li Gongtong of Zhao Commandery took part in Gao Guiyan's rebellion; his mother Lady Cui was the daughter of a younger cousin of Censor-in-Chief Cui Ang, and also the younger sister by marriage of Right Vice Director Wei Shou.
units.literal: Li Gongtong of Zhao Commandery took part in Gao Guiyan's rebellion; his mother Lady Cui was the daughter of a younger cousin of Censor-in-Chief Cui Ang, and also the younger sister by marriage of Right Vice Director Wei Shou.

units.zh: 崔增年陳訴，所司以昂、收故，崔遂獲免。
units.en: Cui added years to her age and submitted a petition; the responsible office, because of Ang and Shou, therefore exempted Cui.
units.literal: Cui added years to her age and submitted a petition; the responsible office, because of Ang and Shou, therefore exempted Cui.

units.zh: 浟摘發其事，昂等以罪除名。
units.en: You exposed the matter; Ang and the others were stripped of their names and offices on account of the crime.
units.literal: You exposed the matter; Ang and the others were stripped of their names and offices on account of the crime.

units.zh: 皇建初，拜大司馬，兼尚書令，轉太保。
units.en: At the beginning of the Huangjian era he was appointed Grand Marshal and Concurrent Chief Minister of the Masters of Writing, then transferred to Grand Tutor.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was appointed Grand Marshal and Concurrent Chief Minister of the Masters of Writing, then transferred to Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 武成入承大業，遷太師、錄尚書事。
units.en: When Gao Zhan succeeded to the great enterprise, he was transferred to Grand Preceptor and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: When Wucheng succeeded to the great enterprise, he was transferred to Grand Preceptor and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 初，博陵崔孝芬取貧家子賈氏以為養女，孝芬死，其妻元更適鄭伯猷，攜賈於鄭氏。
units.en: At first, Cui Xiaofen of Boling took a poor family's daughter of the Jia clan as a foster daughter; when Xiaofen died, his wife Yuan remarried Zheng Boyou and took Jia with her to the Zheng household.
units.literal: At first, Cui Xiaofen of Boling took a poor family's daughter of the Jia clan as a foster daughter; when Xiaofen died, his wife Yuan remarried Zheng Boyou and took Jia with her to the Zheng household.

units.zh: 儀同三司崔孝芬以結婚姻不果，太府卿任集同知營構，頗相乖異，瀛州刺史元晏請托不遂，前後構成其罪，並誅害之。
units.en: Commissioner with protocol equal to the Three Dukes Cui Xiaofen, because a marriage alliance failed; grand steward Ren Ji, who jointly managed construction and often clashed with him; and Ying Province governor Yuan Yan, whose requests went unfulfilled — Longzhi, one after another, fabricated crimes against them, and all were executed.
units.literal: Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Dukes Cui Xiaofen, because a marriage alliance failed; Grand Steward Ren Ji, who jointly managed construction and often clashed with him; and Ying Province governor Yuan Yan, whose requests went unfulfilled — Longzhi, one after another, fabricated crimes against them, and all were executed.

units.zh: 使崔季舒毆之三拳，奮衣而出。
units.en: He had Cui Jishu strike him three blows with the fist, then flung his robes aside and stormed out.
units.literal: He had Cui Jishu strike him three blows with the fist, then flung his robes and went out.

units.zh: 數日前，崔季舒無故於北宮門外諸貴之前誦鮑明遠詩曰：「將軍旣下世，部曲亦罕存。」
units.en: Days before, Cui Jishu for no apparent reason recited before the nobles outside the North Palace Gate a poem of Bao Mingyuan: "The general having left this world, his followers scarcely remain."
units.literal: Days before, Cui Jishu for no apparent reason before the nobles outside the North Palace Gate recited a poem of Bao Mingyuan: "The general having left this world, his followers scarcely remain."

units.zh: 將欲受禪，與陳元康、崔季舒等屏斥左右，署擬百官。
units.en: About to receive the abdication, he with Chen Yuankang, Cui Jishu, and others dismissed attendants and drafted appointments for the hundred offices.
units.literal: About to receive the abdication, he with Chen Yuankang, Cui Jishu, and others dismissed attendants and drafted appointments for the hundred offices.

units.zh: 尋遣季舒入謝。
units.en: Soon he sent Jishu in to apologize.
units.literal: Soon he sent Jishu in to apologize.

units.zh: 東魏主賜季舒彩，季舒未敢即受，啟之於王，王使取一段。
units.en: The Eastern Wei emperor bestowed silk on Jishu; Jishu dared not accept at once and reported to Gao Cheng, who told him to take one bolt.
units.literal: The Eastern Wei emperor bestowed silk on Jishu; Jishu dared not accept at once and reported to the Prince, who told him to take one bolt.

units.zh: 東魏主以四百疋與之，曰：「亦一段耳。」
units.en: The Eastern Wei emperor gave him four hundred bolts and said, "That too is only one bolt."
units.literal: The Eastern Wei emperor gave him four hundred bolts and said: "That too is only one bolt."

units.zh: 之才少解天文，兼圖讖之學，共館客宋景業參校吉兇，知午年必有革易，因高德政啟之。
units.en: Zhicai from youth understood astronomy and also the learning of prognostic texts; with lodge companion Song Jingye he compared auspice and ill omen and knew that in the wu year there would surely be change; he therefore reported this through Gao Dezheng.
units.literal: Zhicai from youth understood astronomy and also the learning of prognostic texts; with lodge companion Song Jingye he compared auspice and ill omen and knew that in the wu year there would surely be change; he therefore reported this through Gao Dezheng.

units.zh: 及帝將建中宮，高隆之、高德正言漢婦人不可為天下母，宜更擇美配。
units.en: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.
units.literal: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.

units.zh: 高元海、畢義雲、高乾乾和等咸數言其短。
units.en: Gao Yuanhai, Bi Yiyun, Gao Qianhe, and others repeatedly denounced him.
units.literal: Gao Yuanhai, Bi Yiyun, Gao Qianhe, and others repeatedly spoke of his faults.

units.zh: 正恨高元海、畢義雲、高乾和誑惑聖上，疾忌忠良。
units.en: I resent only Gao Yuanhai, Bi Yiyun, and Gao Qianhe — they deceive the throne and destroy the loyal.
units.literal: I only resent Gao Yuanhai, Bi Yiyun, and Gao Qianhe for deceiving the sage ruler and envying and destroying the loyal and good.

units.zh: 對曰：「高元海受畢義雲宅，用作本州刺史，給後部鼓吹。
units.en: He replied, "Gao Yuanhai took Bi Yiyun's mansion for his provincial seat and was given rear-guard musicians.
units.literal: He replied: "Gao Yuanhai took Bi Yiyun's mansion and used it as his own provincial seat, and was given rear-guard musicians.

units.zh: 正殺元海、義雲而已。」
units.en: I would kill only Yuanhai and Yiyun."
units.literal: I would kill only Yuanhai and Yiyun."

units.zh: 舊式，百日不上解官，吏部尚書尉瑾性褊急，以瞻舉指舒緩，曹務繁劇，遂附驛奏聞，因而被代。
units.en: Under the old rule, an official absent for one hundred days was removed. Minister of Personnel Wei Jin was narrow and impatient; because Zhan moved slowly while bureau business was heavy and urgent, Wei sent a memorial by post, and Zhan was replaced.
units.literal: Under the old rule, an official who did not appear for one hundred days was removed from office; Minister of Personnel Wei Jin was narrow and impatient by nature, and because Zhan's movements were slow and the bureau's affairs were numerous and urgent, he sent a memorial by post, and Zhan was replaced as a result.

units.zh: 神武明皇后婁氏，諱昭君，贈司徒內干之女也。
units.en: Empress Ming, née Lou, whose personal name was Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Empress Ming, Lady Lou, taboo name Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 神武婁后
units.en: Empress Lou of Shenwu
units.literal: Empress Lou of Shenwu

units.zh: 及拜渤海王妃，閫闈之事悉決焉。
units.en: When she was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.
units.literal: When he was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.

units.zh: 文襄嗣位，進為太妃。
units.en: When Gao Cheng succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.
units.literal: When Wenxiang succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.

units.zh: 天保初，尊為皇太后，宮曰宣訓。
units.en: At the opening of the Tianbao era, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.

units.zh: 孝昭即位，復為皇太后。
units.en: When Gao Yan succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 濟南即位，尊為太皇太后。
units.en: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 太皇太后密與孝昭及諸大將定策誅之，下令廢立。
units.en: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Gao Yan and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing one ruler and enthroning another.
units.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Xiaozhao and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing and enthroning.

units.zh: 大寧二年春，太后寢疾，衣忽自舉，用巫媼言改姓石氏。
units.en: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.
units.literal: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.

units.zh: 孝昭帝崩，太后又下詔立武成帝。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.

units.zh: 及見神武於城上執役，驚曰：「此真吾夫也。」
units.en: When she saw Gao Huan laboring on the city wall, she started and said, "This is truly my husband."
